item.title: Episoda Alpha MCP v2.1.0: Sovereign Hardware-Accelerated Memory Engine Released
item.description: Lalith Chandra announces the release of Episoda Alpha MCP v2.1.0 featuring direct Apple Silicon AMX C-BLAS hardware acceleration (1,248,500 vector comparisons/sec), SQLite WAL storage, 4-Way Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), bi-temporal knowledge graphs, and native Obsidian vault sync.

item.title: How to Setup Episoda Alpha MCP in Claude Desktop & Claude Code CLI
item.description: Step-by-step documentation for installing and running Episoda Alpha MCP in Claude Desktop and Claude Code using uvx episoda-alpha-mcp with sub-2ms query latency.
